He had to prove his own worthiness and did so in a counterproductive way, by drinking and partying too much. He could reframe his Yale years as a prelude to becoming a mature man in his thirties.

questions.prompt: How could emphasizing a worse earlier self affect the narrative?
options: It could make later improvements stand out.
It would erase every objective record.
It proves no improvement occurred.
It would require claiming an ideal adolescence.
questions.promptZh: 强调更差的早年自我怎样影响叙述？
optionsZh: 让后来改善更突出。
抹去所有客观记录。
证明毫无改善。

questions.passage: This is quite a healthy way of thinking about yourself. Indeed, in one study by Anne Wilson and Michael Ross, parents of college students taking an intro to psychology class were asked to report how broadminded, self-confident, socially skilled, and so forth they were relative to other people of the same age on an 11-point scale, ranging from 0 (much less than most) to 5 (same as most) to 10 (much more than most).
questions.prompt: What was the reference point for the parents’ trait ratings?
options: Their children’s grades alone.
Other people of the same age.
Their scores on a mathematics examination.
The researchers’ personal opinion of them.
questions.promptZh: 父母特质评分以什么为参照？
optionsZh: 只看孩子成绩。
其他同龄人。
数学考试分数。
研究者个人意见。
analyses: A 研究父母自评，不是孩子学分。
B relative to...same age 明示比较参照。
C 宽容、自信、社交技能非数学测试。
D 自评不是专家打分。11点含0至10，中点5代表与大多数相同；Anne Wilson与Michael Ross是本研究作者。

evidence.quote: relative to other people of the same age on an 11-point scale

vocabulary.meaning: 宽容的；思想开阔的
vocabulary.context: 列举的自评可取特质之一，非客观智商量度
vocabulary.example: The questionnaire asked how broadminded they considered themselves.

questions.translation: 这是相当健康的自我看法。Anne Wilson与Michael Ross研究让心理学导论学生的父母报告，与同龄人比，自己多宽容、自信、有社交技巧等；用11点量表，0远少于多数、5与多数相同、10远多于多数。
